paragraphs: The Guecha Warrior represents the Muisca on the battlefield. This distinctive skirmisher fights from a distance, trading protection in close combat for the ability to challenge enemy ranged troops.
When a nearby Guecha Warrior falls, surviving companions recover health. Losses can therefore strengthen the endurance of the warriors who remain.
That recovery does not remove their weakness at close range. These battles test whether their ranged attacks and healing can hold an enemy army at bay.
